fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of gross sales (weekly); non-traditional sites pay 6%. Marketing Fee is currently 2.75% of gross sales for franchisees (1.75% for licensees), payable weekly; may increase by 0.5% per 12-month period up to 4% max (above 4% requires majority vote). Local Advertising is currently 1.25% of gross sales. IT Base Services range $5,600–$14,000 per restaurant per year. IT Support Services are currently $250 per restaurant per period (13 periods/year) plus 0.21% of weekly gross sales. Q-Cash card program fee is $7.75/month. Learning Management System fee is $24–$40 per restaurant per month. One-time technology fees include: Technology Support License and Installation $199, Technology Support Project Management and Database Configuration $2,250, License Activation Fees $549. IT Project Services $300–$500 per project plus project costs. Other fees include Transfer (up to $5,000), Renewal ($10,000), Relocation ($5,000), Extension ($1,500/year), Site Visit ($500/visit after first two), Additional/Refresher Training (up to $1,600/trainee), New Restaurant Training Support ($3,500/trainer for 3rd+ restaurant), Audit, Inspection, late payment interest at 18% per annum.
